- Two priority clients have been identified: Craig Shepherd and Gary Smith, requiring focused attention for ongoing management.
- Current LIPS platform clients such as Chris Dickman and Robert Felters will remain due to good results; migration to a new platform is on hold.

- A comprehensive training portal has been established, featuring a video library and community support to aid the onboarding process.

- Transition planning outlines Amanda's training of Andrea, with Andrea expected to take over client management duties after one week of shadowing.
